_orgwave.title: GitHub
_orgwave.purpose: List/filter org repos and GitHub metadata during OrgWave discovery.
env: Optional: run `cd orgwave/mcp-runtime && npm ci` once for fast MCP startup (avoids slow npx cold install).
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in repo-root .env (envFile) — always wins when set.

Default PAT order after that: `gh auth token` (matches terminal gh), then GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN. Stale Cursor-injected GITHUB_TOKEN no longer blocks gh. Set ORGWAVE_MCP_PREFER_ENV_TOKEN=1 in .env or github-mcp.env to prefer env tokens before gh.
~/.cursor/github-mcp.env or ~/.config/orgwave/github-mcp.env merges into empty keys only (even when Cursor passed an empty GITHUB_TOKEN).
~/.zshrc: launcher sources it (non-interactive) and fills GITHUB_* / GH_TOKEN only when still unset.
GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN in the Cursor process env (e.g. launch Cursor from a terminal that exports them).
gh logged in: github-mcp-launch.mjs prepends Homebrew to PATH and runs `gh auth token` with stdin detached so MCP stdio is not consumed.
